trace: The signal will be the 20-day exponential moving average (EMA) of daily closing prices, scaled by the 20-day historical volatility. This choice captures both trend momentum and volatility, using closing prices for their liquidity and smoothing with a shorter EMA period.

The signal will be the 50-day simple moving average (SMA) of daily high prices, scaled by the 10-day historical volatility. This choice emphasizes strong trends using highs for potential peak capturing, while the shorter volatility lookback provides more responsive scaling.
The portfolio will consist of 5 equally weighted positions when a position is opened or closed, ensuring balanced exposure while simplifying management.

The portfolio will hold 30 equally-weighted stock names when a position is opened or closed, ensuring a balanced exposure across selected equities in the Indian market while simplifying implementation and risk management.

For each position, the maximum loss threshold is set to -30% of the entry price to limit potential drawdowns. The strategy will halt trading if any single position's value falls below 50% of its entry price, ensuring overall portfolio stability.

For the risk rule, I propose setting an individual position loss bound of -3% to limit potential losses on any single stock position. Additionally, the strategy will halt trading if the total portfolio loss exceeds -5%, ensuring overall risk is managed effectively.

The risk rule will be that each individual position's loss is capped at -3%, and the total portfolio loss is capped at -5%. If either bound is breached, trading will be halted for a cooling-off period of one week before resuming.
